overview: We audit your Shopify store for the things that slow it down and hold back search visibility, then fix them in your account. That covers image sizes, unused apps and code, page titles and descriptions, product and collection structure, and the sitemap. You get a before and after speed check and a short written summary. We aim to make pages load faster and easier for search engines to read, and we do not promise rankings.

faq: Only with your say-so. We list which apps add the most load and what each one does, then trim leftover code from apps you already uninstalled. You choose which apps stay and which go.
Can you promise a Google ranking or speed score?
No. Rankings depend on many things we do not control, and speed scores shift with every test. We fix what we can measure, show before and after results, and explain anything that is left.
Do you change my page addresses?
Not unless there is a reason. Where we must change one, we add a 301 redirect and note it in the report, so no shopper lands on a dead page and search engines learn where it moved.
Is this a one-off or ongoing?

This is a fixed sprint: the audit and the first round of fixes. Ongoing SEO, content and monthly speed checks are quoted separately, and we can talk through what makes sense once you have read the report.
